**Requirement ids:** **Owner (spec §56):** SIG-CONF-003, SIG-CONF-006,
SIG-CONF-007. **Also:** SIG-CONF-009 (the check; owner P35.34).
**Cited (context, owned elsewhere):** SIG-CONF-001 (basis classes;

pass). **Ticket:**
`docs/tickets/255_P34.44a__quality-check-registry-and-ratchet-engine.md`
(manifest row 255, Round 11 / P34, sub-round 11A) · **Base:**
`r11/P34.49-part-viii-at-rest-audit` (stacked, H2 PR-1) · **Gate:**

## Why

SIG cannot hold a quality gain it cannot measure. L2's read found 27
graph-quality questions — 17 already failing — but nothing declared them
as a ruleset, ran them read-only, or stopped a regression from slipping
back in. ADR-154 decided the shape: a versioned registry of the checks,
a ratchet that lets a baseline move only toward its threshold, and
`enforce` flips that happen only in each check's fixing row. This row
engineers that system (ADR-154 decisions 1/2/4): the registry, the
evaluator contract, the ratchet engine, the read-only harness and the
records — so P34.44b's baseline run has something to run, and every
later gain is held by construction.

## What ships

- **`exports/src/exports/data/quality_checks.toml`** —
  `sig.quality-checks/1`: the versioned registry declaring all **27
  checks GQ-01…GQ-27** — id, statement, population, placement
  (I/M/R/P/S), mode (`enforce`/`ratchet`/`report`), direction,
  threshold, baseline (L2's numbers as placeholders; `"pending"` where
  P34.44b's baseline run sets the measured value), unit, basis class
  (B0–B5), fixing row (CONF/PKG/GX/H-4/REL-04b/G2/TX-04 keys mapped to
  manifest rows), source ids and notes.
- **`exports/src/exports/quality.py`** — the ruleset: `load_registry` +
  `validate_registry` (schema, complete GQ id set, manifest-checked
  fixing rows, **SIG-CONF-003 gating-mode refusal** — B3/B4 evidence may
  never gate), `evaluate_check` (the ratchet verdict: regression past
  baseline fails; improvement records; `unbaselined` pending baselines
  never gate; **SIG-ENG-042** — 0 evaluated is a fail, never a pass),
  `summarize`/`build_quality_report`/`build_probe_run` (the
  `sig.quality-report/1` + `sig.probe-run/1` records, `class_s_trigger`
  for P35.60's classifier), `run_release_gate` (the standalone V15 hook
  — a `not_evaluable` `enforce` check **fails closed**), and
  `diff_registry` (the ratchet's rules on the ruleset: baselines move
  only toward thresholds, threshold loosenings/removals/mode-weakenings
  need a cited new-ADR id, an `enforce` flip is legal only in the
  check's fixing row).
- **`ops/src/ops/quality.py` + `sig-ops quality run|gate`** — the
  read-only harness: `connect_readonly` opens the spine in the
  `sig_audit` posture (`default_transaction_read_only=on`, 60 s
  statement timeout); nine spine evaluators (GQ-03/05/07/11/13/15/18/
  21/24) run bounded SELECT-only probes — heavy checks take
  `TABLESAMPLE … REPEATABLE` with the seed recorded; file-scan
  evaluators (GQ-14/27) read a `--scan-dir` release/build tree; the
  thirteen checks whose seams do not exist yet report `not_evaluable`
  naming the owning row (`SEAM_DEFERRALS` — GQ-02/06/08/09/10/12/16/
  17/19/20/23/25/26), never a pass. `gate --report` emits the
  `sig.quality-gate/1` verdict.
- **`sig-exports quality validate|diff`** — the ruleset verbs beside the
  registry's package.
- **ADR-204** — the registry schema, the outcome vocabulary
  (`pass | fail | not_evaluable | unbaselined`; evaluated=0 is a fail)
  and the ruleset-diff rules; Appendix F row + ADR index + trigger
  register + BL-084 home.
- Tests: `tests/exports/test_quality_registry.py` (15),
  `test_quality_engine.py` (36), `tests/ops/test_quality_runner.py`
  (20), `tests/db/test_quality_probe.py` (3, Docker).

## Boundaries

Read-only end to end: the harness opens one read-only session, every
evaluator is SELECT-only, and `not_evaluable`/`unbaselined` are recorded
honestly rather than fabricating coverage. GQ-11 treats every overlap as
undeclared until CONF-04's lineage seam lands; GQ-13's distinct-literal
approximation is disclosed in the record. No `ingestion_permitted` flip,
no `HG-nn` ticked, no `UPDATE`/`DELETE` on the spine. **OM-16:** ~3.73k
changed lines excl. generated — over the 3,000 M budget; recorded as a
deviation in the run ledger (P34.43 ~3.1k / P34.49 ~3.8k precedent).
